Organizations & Factions

Browse all available Grand RP organizations, their roles, and access full command references for each faction.

Government

Government

The supreme legal authority managing state laws, licenses, and the economy. Led by the Governor — high-stakes political roleplay at the pinnacle of power.

View Commands
Federal Agency

Federal Investigation Bureau

Premier elite agency handling high-level criminal investigations, undercover stings, and counter-terrorism. Advanced surveillance and tactical gear to dismantle organized crime at the federal level.

View Commands
City Police

Los Santos Police Dept.

Primary city law enforcement. Patrols city limits, responds to 911 calls, and processes arrests at Mission Row. The foundational faction for tactical and legal roleplay.

View Commands
Highway Patrol

San Andreas Highway Patrol

Specialized for state highways, rural counties, and out-of-city jurisdictions. High-speed interceptors for pursuits and smuggling prevention.

View Commands
Medical

Emergency Medical Services

Vital neutral faction. Responds to emergencies, revives downed players, and provides healthcare at Pillbox Hill using ambulances and helicopters.

View Commands
Military

National Guard

Primary military force at Fort Zancudo. Secures weapon shipments, supports agencies during emergencies with armored vehicles and aircraft.

View Commands
Media

Lifeinvader

The main media organization of Los Santos, publishing daily news about the city — from updates on legal organizations and crime, to advertising and incident reports. The go-to source for everything happening across Los Santos.
